channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Marines train to destroy enemy drones with shotguns during Steel Knight 25
item.description: Marines at Camp Pendleton are learning how to shoot down small enemy drones with shotguns thanks to a new training course introduced during Exercise Steel Knight 25.

item.title: The Social Diary – Festive charity fun-raising!
item.description: The Athenaeum is generously supported by the community as well as the Dr. Seuss Fund, the Conrad Prebys Foundation, and Las Patronas.

item.title: Crime-fighting tool or privacy menace? Residents weigh in on SDPD surveillance
item.description: We asked residents if they approve of the council’s action on ALPR cameras and more or if the technologies' effect on privacy concerns them.

item.title: They power the U.S. economy but will struggle to afford health care
item.description: Health insurance costs will skyrocket for millions of Americans if tax credits expire. Small business owners and the self-employed will be hit hard.

item.title: Rob Reiner was more than a Hollywood legend. He helped shape California politics
item.description: Rob Reiner may be best known for his Hollywood films, but he was also a Democratic political force in California.

item.title: How San Diego’s reliance on ‘hostile architecture’ reflects our abandonment of public space
item.description: The concept is used to describe public infrastructure design in San Diego and beyond that is intended to change behavior.

item.title: Republicans ask federal court to overturn California’s new Prop. 50 maps
item.description: Republicans are staking their Prop. 50 challenge on the argument that California’s primary mapmaker illegally used race as a factor.

item.title: Police SWAT team responds to barricaded suspect in Gaslamp
item.description: Multiple police vehicles converged on the 200 block of J Street in the Gaslamp shortly after noon on Tuesday.

item.title: City of San Diego signs off on first update to College Area Community Plan in over 30 years
item.description: It also plans for new public spaces, including a linear park along Montezuma Road, and streets designed with wide sidewalks, shade trees, and landscaping that promote pedestrian activity and support local businesses.

item.title: 100-unit affordable housing community ‘The Iris’ opens in San Ysidro
item.description: Housing developer National CORE, the San Diego Housing Commission, the county and city of San Diego celebrated the grand opening Tuesday of a 100-unit affordable housing community in San Ysidro.
